projects.title: 桌巡喵
projects.subtitle: ZhuoXunMiao · HarmonyOS PC
projects.one_liner_zh: 鸿蒙电脑上的桌面清扫机器人。
projects.detail_zh: 它在真实桌面上巡扫，可以按类型整理文件、移入回收站或永久删除，每一步都先让你确认。
projects.one_liner_en: A desktop-sweeping robot for HarmonyOS PCs.
projects.detail_en: It patrols your real desktop, sorts, recycles or deletes files, and asks before every step.

projects.title: ReWords AI
projects.subtitle: Web · iOS · HarmonyOS
projects.one_liner_zh: 用 AI 改图片里的文字。
projects.detail_zh: 识别原图上的字，换成你要的内容，文字区域以外的像素不动。Web、iOS、鸿蒙三端。
projects.one_liner_en: Edit the text inside any image with AI.
projects.detail_en: It reads the text, swaps in what you want, and leaves every pixel outside the text region untouched.

projects.title: project-brain-map
projects.subtitle: Agent skill
projects.one_liner_zh: 读懂整个项目的 Agent skill。
projects.detail_zh: 读源码和文档，生成一份可交互的项目大脑地图 HTML，包含能力树、业务流程、DDD 架构和 Mermaid 图，每条结论都标明证据。
projects.one_liner_en: An agent skill that maps an entire project.
projects.detail_en: It reads your code and docs and builds an interactive, evidence-backed brain map with capability trees, flows, DDD and Mermaid diagrams.
